text: Seek refuge in God from him; According to the Almighty’s saying: “So seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing” (Al-A’raf: 200).
And God Almighty says: “And say, ‘My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils.’” Al-Mu’minun: 97
Reading Surat Al-Baqarah; Because of his saying - may God bless him and grant him peace -: Satan flees from the house in which Surat Al-Baqarah is recited.
